description: This file defines a NotesProvider class that manages CRUD operations, filtering, sorting, and business logic for notes in a Flutter application using Hive for local persistence.

classes.name: NotesProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier that manages a list of notes, providing CRUD operations, search, and sorting functionalities.

methods.name: _refresh
methods.description: Loads notes from local storage into the _notes list and notifies listeners.

methods.name: allNotes
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable list of all notes.

methods.name: filteredNotes
methods.description: Returns a list of notes filtered by search term and sorted by update time.

methods.name: searchTerm
methods.description: Getter for the current search term.

methods.name: sortDescending
methods.description: Getter for the current sort order.

methods.name: addNote
methods.description: Adds a new note to storage and refreshes the list.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Updates properties of an existing note and saves it.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Deletes a note from storage and refreshes the list.

methods.name: setSearchTerm
methods.description: Sets the search term used for filtering notes.
